channel.title: Crypto Record
channel.description: Crypto Record reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto market.

item.title: DOJ wins authority over $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department won authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack funds, part of over $2.7 billion already frozen.

item.title: US wins authority over $1.2bn in crypto stolen from Binance
item.description: The Justice Department says it has court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, as tracing and freezes continue.

item.title: US targets $1.2 billion in crypto stolen from Binance
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion in Binance hack funds, as partners freeze assets and tracing continues.

item.title: Zcash holders to vote on moving 50,000 ZEC from grants fund
item.description: Zcash holders and community panels will vote Nov. 16–30 on moving 50,000 ZEC into a mining reserve, while ending the grants program’s automatic 8% issuance share.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad for participating issuers and acquirers to settle obligations in stablecoins, adding another blockchain rail to its growing program.

item.title: Coinbase’s national trust charter takes effect under OCC oversight
item.description: Coinbase says the OCC finalized its trust charter, placing planned institutional crypto custody under federal oversight while keeping the entity outside deposit banking.

item.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed hashes and live tokens for all users
item.description: Chainalysis says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed, prompting credential resets and service shutdowns across key products.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34 billion hack to fake job interview
item.description: Binance says a fake job interview led into a months-long breach that moved $6.34 billion through hot wallets using Ethereum’s EIP-7702 permissions.

item.title: FinCEN orders U.S. firms to block transfers involving MEXC
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. financial firms to block transfers to and from MEXC after alleging $16.7 billion in illicit flows, putting its U.S. payment links at risk.

item.title: Fed and OCC ask banks about systems after Binance hack
item.description: After Binance reported a $6.3 billion hot-wallet loss, Fed and OCC supervisors asked banks about unusual activity and outages, prompting security checks.

item.title: Fake interviews helped enable Binance’s $6.34B wallet theft
item.description: Binance says a fake hiring campaign helped attackers reach wallet systems before $6.34 billion in crypto was taken, exposing a months-long breach at the exchange.

item.title: FBI ties $6bn Binance theft to North Korea’s TraderTraitor
item.description: The FBI says North Korea stole more than $6bn from Binance on Oct. 29; its alert asks crypto firms to block wallets as stolen coins move through swaps.

item.title: Is EigenLayer a Layer 2? How Restaking Differs From Rollups
item.description: EigenLayer is a restaking protocol on Ethereum, not a rollup or Layer 2; rollups may use its opt-in operators for selected security and validation services.

item.title: Binance and Deribit cut SignalPlus API access
item.description: Binance and Deribit revoked SignalPlus API keys after a reported security issue, cutting automated trading access while saying their own systems were unaffected.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34 billion theft to fake job interview
item.description: Binance says attackers used a fake interview, malware and internal access to reach wallet signing systems, enabling $6.34 billion in unauthorized transfers.

item.title: Binance details $6.34 billion wallet-signing incident
item.description: Binance says attackers used its wallet-signing service to move $6.34 billion across networks; $2.85 billion was frozen or intercepted, and it will cover losses.

item.title: Binance paused withdrawals after $6.3bn hot-wallet breach
item.description: Binance says attackers stole about $6.3bn through its hot-wallet signing service; withdrawals were paused as it revoked on-chain permissions and froze assets.

item.title: NEAR governance backs gradual cut to 1.6% issuance ceiling
item.description: NEAR’s House of Stake approved a 24-month plan to lower the token issuance ceiling to 1.6%, but a validator upgrade is still needed to activate it.

item.title: Securitize plans Stellar integration for tokenized assets
item.description: Securitize plans to add Stellar for issuing and managing tokenized financial products, giving asset managers another network option while product and launch dates remain open.

item.title: Four Checks Before Spending Bridged Tokens
item.description: Four checks help confirm that bridged tokens are the asset and chain you intend to use, and that the transaction can complete at an acceptable cost.
